_note: Japan edition (kreelz.com/jp) channels, collected by scripts/japan.mjs. Their videos are shown only on /jp. q = YouTube channel search used once to find the channel; title = the channel name must match this; min = minimum subscribers; korean = the channel also posts non-Korean content, keep only Korean titles; artist = Music priority artist the channel belongs to. id is filled in when found. not = reject channels whose name matches this. searched = last day a search found nothing (tried again after 7 days). ENHYPEN, TXT, LE SSERAFIM, BOYNEXTDOOR, ILLIT and TWS have no separate Japan channel (checked 2026-10-26): their Japanese releases are on the main channels. cat: screen = OTT (drama/film, shows and music by keywords), tv = Korean TV channel in Japan (same rules), music = an artist's channel. handle / video = find the channel by its @handle or by one of its videos (exact, 1 API unit); playlist = also take that playlist; reco = Korean creator lifted in the /jp K-Travel & Food tab (not Japan-only). top = one of the top picked creators: first places in the /jp K-Travel & Food tab (JP_TOP_ONLY=1 collects just these); only = keep only titles matching this; first = videos to take on the first run. skip = drop titles matching this. visit = restaurant-visit videos only (scripts/japan.mjs visitOK). food = food and restaurant videos only (scripts/japan.mjs foodOK).

actors._note: Ranked actors on kreelz.com/jp (scripts/actors.mjs JP_ACTORS, Japanese fan ranking): Japanese uploads of their romance scenes (3 of 7 kinds), fan meetings, visits to Japan / events / fancams and fan-made videos. Queries = Japanese actor name + kind, rotating. Taken only when the actor is named and it is not a full re-upload (max 30 min).
